**Tickets**

The digest says "the account Nadia runs," which is the Group account by my reading of the 5/4 handoff digest. Treat the attribution as unconfirmed.

4. **INC-4821**, Vantorre Group (Hartford)

5. **VT-55120**, Vantorre Group (Hartford)

**Not included**

- #PD-4402 is Quillfeather Outfitters, not Vantorre.
- The 3/10/2025 digest mentions Mateo's gate check-in emails, but it has no ticket number.

Sources I read: #strategic-pod (full history), #inc-vtg-hartford (full history), and the nine Moss digest files plus the cheat sheet. The cheat sheet has no ticket numbers. The brain search was keyword-only, so I relied on the channel and file reads.
